verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents registrable outbound webhooks managed through webhook API endpoints. A WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhook type pushes screening outcomes to a configured URL, so developers need not poll. Delivery includes a stable per-webhook identifier reused across retries for idempotency. Only a completion event is evidenced, not a full lifecycle, and nothing shows payload signing. missing for 10: evidence of webhook signature verification, distinct lifecycle event types (created, processing, requires-input), independent or hands-on corroboration.
